headline: Best Mining Pal in Palworld
title: Best Mining Pal in Palworld | Aegidron | Palworld Base Guide
video_script: Who is the best Mining Pal in Palworld one point zero? It's Aegidron, with level eight Mining. Aegidron is story gated, so Knocklem is the mining king for most of the game. The best alternative is Knocklem, with level seven Mining and level seven Transporting. Tip: condense your workers to four stars to raise every work level by one. Who does Mining at your base? Comment below!
description: The best Mining Pal in Palworld 1.0 is Aegidron (level 8 Mining). Alternative: Knocklem (level 7 Mining and level 7 Transporting). Condensing to 4 stars raises every work suitability by 1.
